name: Lin Nakamura
source:
Lin Nakamura, [url=https://vndb.org/c148167]Emma[/url]'s mother. A sweet and caring old woman who has only shown you kindness, though she worries quite a bit about her three daughters. She used to be married to a man named [url=https://vndb.org/c148193]Chen[/url], who happened to be a friend of your [url=https://vndb.org/c148155]father[/url]'s, but they've been divorced for as long as you could remember

[In game description]
